item.title: CVE-2026-109962: When a Froxlor Reseller Can Read the Admin's Server Config
item.dc:creator: Rajnish Kumar
item.description: Froxlor API read commands for MySQL servers and cronjobs skipped the change_serversettings check, letting resellers read admin-only configuration. Fixed in 2.3.14.

item.title: CVE-2026-100682: How a PWA Icon ZIP Turns a Budibase Builder into Root
item.dc:creator: Rajnish Kumar
item.description: A symlink-following ZIP extraction bug in the Budibase PWA icon upload let BUILDER users write files as root and reach RCE. Responsibly disclosed 21 Aug 2026, fixed in 3.45.0.
